sources.name: IRS SOI Tax Stats — Migration Data, county-to-county inflow, Filing Year 2022-2023
sources.note: National county-to-county inflow file (all destination counties, all origin counties), CSV, downloaded directly from irs.gov. Fields: y2_statefips, y2_countyfips (destination), y1_statefips, y1_countyfips (origin), y1_state, y1_countyname, n1 (returns/households), n2 (exemptions/individuals), agi. 90,049 raw rows.

sources.name: IRS SOI Tax Stats — Migration Data, county-to-county outflow, Filing Year 2022-2023
sources.note: National county-to-county outflow file (all origin counties, all destination counties), CSV, downloaded directly from irs.gov. Fields: y1_statefips, y1_countyfips (origin), y2_statefips, y2_countyfips (destination), y2_state, y2_countyname, n1, n2, agi. 90,359 raw rows.

sources.name: IRS 2022-2023 Migration Data Users Guide (record layouts, disclosure-protection rules, special summary level codes)
sources.note: Authoritative documentation used to derive the exclusion rules (Sections C.4, D, E.3, E.4, E.6) applied to build this layer.
